verdict.rationale: The pack cites Administration REST API documentation, but nothing shows a downloadable machine-readable spec such as OpenAPI or Swagger. Probes of common OpenAPI paths on keycloak.org all returned 404. The OIDC well-known configuration endpoint is protocol discovery metadata, not an API specification, so it is only adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
